title: 第18章 入品武者，孔家大公子
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
“肃静，让管事的出来说话。”

    任忠武大声喝到。

    村民肃静，看看他，又看看已经死去多时的孙友成。

    “大人，这人就是管事的，他是南山村村正家的大儿子，可却联合小儿子孙友文一起，想要劫掠春税。”

    有人站出来讲述。

    “大人，若不是陆林，我们这些人都要被杀死，请大人一定要严惩凶手，为我们死去的亲人报仇啊。”

    这人说着，直接跪倒在地。

    “请大人严惩凶手，为我们报仇。”

    余下众人也纷纷跪倒。

    场中，只有陆林手拿弓箭站在那里。

    任忠武的目光在陆林身上打量一番，随即收回目光，“诸位乡亲请起，我是白杨镇衙门捕头任忠武，你们放心，此事我一定会管到底。”

    “褚二，牛三，你们过来，帮乡亲们一起处理。”

    “是大人。”

    两名皂衣捕快上前。

    任忠武跳下巨石，走向陆林。

    神秀内敛。

    面色平静。

    明明只是个十几岁的少年，身上却又一股成熟沉稳的气质。

    一个小山村，能养出这样的少年，日后定能乘风而起。

    任忠武对陆林的好感拉到满点。

    “草民陆林，南山村猎户，见过任大人。”

    陆林率先行礼，却被任忠武拉住。

    “好说好说，果然是少年英雄，小兄弟今年多大了，学习箭术几年了。”

    手一搭在陆林的胳膊上，感受到陆林那强壮的骨骼，有力的肌肉，任忠武再次确认了陆林的实力。

    “回大人，草民今年十六，学习箭术已有三年。”

    “三年？就能练到这种程度，一箭射杀余涛，你这少年果然不简单啊。”

    跟陆林聊了两句，那边村民的尸体也都搬上了马车。

    赤山盗的尸体，则由褚二，牛三负责勘验。

    马车上的银两，也由二人清点数目。

    这种情况，村民自然不可能再去镇上。

    只是他们想要返回，却犯了难。

    前后都有堵路的巨石。

    那巨石有一人多高，少说也有五千斤。

    几个村民合力竟然也难以推开。

    “乡亲们，让我来吧。”
content_en:
"Be quiet and let the person in charge speak."

    Ren Zhongwu drank loudly.

    The villagers were silent, looking at him and then at Sun Youcheng, who had been dead for a long time.

    "Sir, this man is in charge. He is the eldest son of the Muramasa family in Nanshan Village, but he teamed up with his younger son Sun Youwen to rob the spring tax."

    Someone stood up and told.

    "Sir, if it weren't for Lu Lin, all of us would have been killed. Please, please punish the murderer severely and avenge our dead relatives."

    The man said and fell to his knees.

    "Please punish the murderer severely and avenge us."

    The rest of the people also knelt down.

    In the field, only Lu Lin stood there with a bow and arrow in hand.

    Ren Zhongwu looked at Lu Lin for a while, then withdrew his gaze and said, "Fellow folks, please call me. I am Ren Zhongwu, the head of Baiyang Town Yamen's arrest. Don't worry, I will take care of this matter to the end."

    "Chu Er, Niu San, come here and help the villagers deal with it."

    "It's my lord."

    Two Zaoyi detectives stepped forward.

    Ren Zhongwu jumped off the boulder and walked towards Lu Lin.

    Shenxiu is restrained.

    His face was calm.

    He is obviously just a teenager, but he has a mature and calm temperament.

    If a small mountain village can raise such a young man, he will definitely be able to ride on the wind and rise in the future.

    Ren Zhongwu had a good impression of Lu Lin.

    "Lu Lin, a grassroots man and a hunter in Nanshan Village, has met Mr. Ren."

    Lu Lin took the lead in saluting, but was stopped by Ren Zhongwu.

    "It's easy to talk about. He is indeed a young hero. How old is my little brother? He has been studying archery for several years."

    As soon as he put his hand on Lu Lin's arm and felt Lu Lin's strong bones and powerful muscles, Ren Zhongwu once again confirmed Lu Lin's strength.

    "Sir, Cao Min is sixteen this year and has been learning archery for three years."

    "Three years? You can practice to this level and kill Yu Tao with one arrow. It's really not easy for a young man like you."

    After chatting with Lu Lin for a few words, the bodies of the villagers over there were also loaded onto the carriage.

    Chu Er and Niu San were responsible for the inspection of the bodies of the Chishan bandits.

    The silver coins on the carriage were also counted by two people.

    In this case, it is naturally impossible for the villagers to go to the town again.

    It's just that they want to return, but they have trouble.

    There are huge rocks blocking the road in front and behind.

    The boulder is as tall as a person and weighs at least five thousand kilograms.

    Even with the combined efforts of several villagers, it was difficult to push him away.

    "Folks, let me do it."
title_en: Chapter 18 A top-grade warrior, the eldest son of the Kong family
